title: Optimus Energy Chooses EMSYS VPP for Greek Market
text:
The future of energy in Greece is being reshaped, as Optimus Energy joins forces with EMSYS VPP to optimize its renewable energy portfolio. This strategic partnership introduces cutting-edge Virtual Power Plant (VPP) technology,promising to enhance market presence,stabilize the grid,and unlock new revenue streams. Learn how this collaboration is setting a new standard for renewable energy management in Greece.
Optimus Energy Partners with EMSYS VPP to Optimize Renewable Energy Portfolio in Greece Strategic collaboration aims to enhance market presence and grid stability through advanced virtual power plant technology.
© Pexels
Key takeaways Optimus Energy,a leading direct marketer of renewable energies in Greece,commissions EMSYS VPP to provide a virtual power plant (VPP). The partnership aims to market Optimus Energy’s extensive 4 GW solar and wind energy portfolio on the Greek spot and regulator market. EMSYS VPP’s software-as-a-service ( SaaS ) solution will connect over 3,500 solar and wind turbines, providing real-time data and dynamic control. The collaboration includes implementing a special software module for control energy , enhancing revenue options and contributing to network stability. Strategic Alliance for Renewable Energy Dominance Oldenburg, Germany – Athens-Optimus Energy, a prominent direct marketer specializing in renewable energies and demand response services in Greece, has partnered with German technology provider EMSYS VPP to deploy its virtual power plant (VPP) technology. This strategic move aims to optimize the marketing of Optimus Energy’s substantial portfolio of solar and wind energy assets within the Greek energy market.
The collaboration positions Optimus Energy to leverage EMSYS VPP’s proven software solution, already utilized by direct marketers and energy suppliers across Europe. This access is expected to substantially enhance Optimus Energy’s market presence and operational efficiency.
Harnessing 4 GW of Renewable Power The primary objective of this partnership is to effectively market Optimus Energy’s extraordinary portfolio of nearly 4,000 MW (4 GW) of solar and wind energy on the Greek spot and regulator market. This represents approximately 50 percent of the regenerative energy capacities marketed in the market premium model or without funding, underscoring Optimus Energy’s notable role in the Greek renewable energy landscape.
Technological Implementation and Real-Time Control EMSYS VPP has commenced the implementation of the virtual power plant, tailoring the software to meet Optimus Energy’s specific requirements. This includes connecting over 3,500 solar and wind turbines to the VPP, enabling real-time data acquisition and dynamic control of electricity generation. Energy & Meteo Systems, a partner company of EMSYS VPP, will provide precise solar and wind performance forecasts for the integrated systems.
Enhancing Grid Stability and Revenue Streams A key component of the implementation is a specialized software module designed for providing control energy. This functionality not only unlocks additional revenue opportunities but also bolsters network stability through enhanced operational flexibility. The scope of services also encompasses the qualification of solar and wind farms for participation in the control market, further integrating renewable energy sources into the grid.
Executive Perspectives Stella Zacharia, CEO of Optimus Energy, emphasized the strategic importance of the partnership: We benefit from the cooperation from the industry-leading software solutions and the international expertise of EMSYS VPP in order to exploit the potential of our solar and wind farms in the best possible way. She further highlighted the broader implications, stating that the partnership contributes to the stabilization of the Greek electricity system and opens up new sources of income in the area of ​​system services.
Dr. Ulrich Focken, Managing Director of EMSYS VPP and Energy & Meteo Systems, echoed this sentiment:
The provision of our virtual power plant for Optimus Energy is an vital milestone in our market presence. Dr. Ulrich Focken, Managing Director of EMSYS VPP and Energy & Meteo Systems
Published: April 9, 2025
